schemas.relevant_read: fetches issue comments across all pages for deterministic post-write reconciliation

schemas.relevant_cleanup: can replace body but does not remove the server-side comment record

tested_scope.not_tested: No external issue/PR comment was created, updated, or deleted; no repository semantics outside the evaluation namespace were consumed.

ambiguous_write_reconciliation.reason: A caller-generated unique operation key can be embedded in the comment body before mutation. After a lost create response, fetching all comments for the known issue/PR can deterministically search for that exact key and recover the server record before any retry. Multiple matches must be treated as conflict rather than success.

cleanup_or_bounded_retention.reason: The exposed comment surface provides update but no delete or TTL. Replacing a body with a tombstone cannot bound the number of persistent server-side comment records, so operation-record accumulation is unbounded.
